about: Who narrates explainer clips, and the voice of every cast character. A clip names its map zone (the island ids in game/ui/map.gd, plus foundations) and is narrated by that zone's tutor; recordings go in game/assets/audio/voice/<tutor>/clips/<clip id>/, and explainer lines in game/assets/audio/voice/explainers/<script id>/<line id>.ogg. Tutors are the regional cast from GitHub issue #18; story characters are under 'characters'. The board cast each voice on Gemini text-to-speech (FAL-927, 2026-11-15). On FAL-1110 (2026-11-17) Matt moved every voice to a local VoxCPM2 clone in 'ultimate' mode: each voice's Gemini reference take (reference) is cloned on our own GPU for every line, so lines cost nothing and the voice stays the same from line to line. An approved voice is fixed: every line is recorded with the same provider, model, mode, reference take, settings and processing. Changing any of them means re-recording every line for that character. Nothing may be recorded for a clip until its tutor is approved. Credit each line as 'Generated locally with VoxCPM2 by OpenBMB (Apache-2.0), cloned from a reference recorded with Gemini text-to-speech (<reference.recorded.model>, voice <reference.recorded.voice>) via the Gemini API', with the seed and the date. The recording tool is falcon-voice clone/ (record.py, post.sh, check.py).
voice_template: Right, gather round, this is the one thing worth knowing out here. Last August a thick cloud of red dust rolled over the bazaar, and the big water pump choked and quit. We measured the pressure, checked the gauge twice, and found the fault: a worn valve, jammed solid with sand and old oil. Would you believe it? Four squared is sixteen, and a half plus a quarter makes three quarters. Fix the valve, get the sums right, and everybody drinks again. So here's my choice, and I'm sure of it: keep your tools sharp, your thoughts clear, and never guess when you can work it out.

clone_settings.about: Every voice is cloned the same way: reference_wav_path and prompt_wav_path are its reference take, prompt_text is voice_template (VoxCPM2 "ultimate" mode).
clone_settings.seeds: 1099 first; 1100, 1101 and 1102 for a line that fails its word check

tin-can-tess.name: Tin-Can Tess

recorded.direction: the direction below, word for word

tin-can-tess.direction: A woman in her thirties with a strong, natural New Zealand English accent, clearly Kiwi on every line.
